title: remanence
author: diid
facts: convolutional image decoder (4 convolution layers, two output heads)
1,512 convolution weights (int16) plus 110,592 stored fragment values (latents)
data contracts (SSTORE2): weights, activation tables, and the fragments (latents) of 16 paintings
one 192×144 indexed-color BMP image, computed inside Ethereum
description: remanence stores sixteen paintings on Ethereum as compressed fragments. A small neural network, called a decoder, turns fragments back into a picture. The decoder weights and the fragments are in data contracts. The model runs inside Ethereum. One read-only call runs every layer and returns a finished image. Collectors combine fragments to restore a painting, or mix paintings into a hybrid picture (a chimera).

call.note: tokenURI(tokenId) runs the decoder on the fragments of the selected token and returns the image as token metadata.

input.label: TOKEN ID
input.hint: Enter the ID of a token that exists. A token that nobody has minted (created), or that its owner burned (destroyed), cannot return an image.

preview.note: Ethereum computes this image from the fragments of the selected token. If the owner burns (destroys) the token, this call stops returning an image.
